assertion_map.source_inventory_note: The test attribute inventory is a source check. It is not a test-run receipt. Conditional platform attributes remain in source.

runtime_correction: Declare the cache reservation before compiled code. Failure drops code before its cache charge. Existing failure-admission assertions check full capacity after return; they do not observe the native destructor timing.
architecture_change: Native in-process Component::new replaces compiler processes, request and reply pipes, CBOR framing, PID checks and fixed process CPU and wall limits.
unsupported: Configured in-process compiler working-memory limits return typed Unsupported.
Synchronous native compilation is not preemptible. Explicit cancellation joins the actual worker before acknowledgement.
Cache and image limits do not bound peak compiler working memory.
final_rust_gate: Not done for this source. The earlier full run stops at the OCI fixture. Its test-only correction passes all 15 Package cases. A complete final gate is still required after the last covered edit.
assertion_map_status: The map retains the original audit wording. The current qualification records run all mapped active Runtime tests and relevant Query cases. Removed subprocess assertions have no active protocol boundary.
